amendmentAdditions: R-SUB substitution check (archive vs NWS API) and its gating of criteria
R-5.1R replaces 5.1 by a replay self-consistency check; it is NOT the plan's 5.1
RAIN_ONSET truth-onset definition (p01i >= 0.01 in after a measured 3 h dry lookback)
merging of a lake's Brain events of one kind within 2 h
5.3 minimum sample (30 truth events, 30 Brain events, 10 lakes)
front truth from 0.1 deg CODSUS bulletins, COLD/WARM/OCFNT within 50 mi; Brain fronts with no eligible analysis within +/- 3 h excluded from FAR
independent station at least 3 mi from every Brain station
excluded spans for the disclosed fixtures
why: Plan section 5 can only start on activation day because the NWS observation API keeps about 7 days. Station observations of the same ASOS/AWOS stations are archived by the Iowa Environmental Mesonet (IEM) from the same METAR reports, and WPC coded surface bulletins are archived as NWS text products. The Brain's reading and signal logic is pure (brains/weather/runtime/sector_weather/reading.py assemble, signal.py evaluate), so it can be replayed on archived reports at past instants and graded now.

windows.evaluationInstants: Every hour at HH:10:00Z, from 'from' inclusive to 'to' exclusive. One instant = one simulated Brain run (the Orchestrator grants hourly; the minute is fixed here, not chosen after seeing data).

archiveFetch.why: 13 h lookback before the first instant (the Brain's OBS_LOOKBACK_HOURS) and 3 h after the last instant (the truth tolerances)

windows.choice: The window ends 4 days before registration so the archives are settled. It is autumn only; results are not claimed for other seasons.

lakes.population: Every lake in the Engine lake directory (GET https://sector-engine-e43utajroa-uc.a.run.app/lakes, the Brain's own directory source) at run time. The runner records the directory count and its sha256. Lakes where NWS /points returns 404 are BLOCKED (WX-004) and are counted, not graded. Lakes whose stations are FLAGGED by R-SUB are excluded and counted.
lakes.subsetRuns: A run on a subset (--lakes or --limit) is a smoke test: its report is labelled SUBSET and no criterion in it may be reported as PASS or FAIL.

stationSelection.brainStations: Exactly as the Brain selects them (publish.py resolve_point): NWS /points/{lat:.4f},{lon:.4f} -> observationStations, decode_stations order, the first MAX_STATIONS = 3. The NWS list is read once at run time and assumed unchanged over the window; the runner records it.
stationSelection.perInstantPick: At each instant the Brain's assemble() picks, per tile, the newest fresh report among its 3 stations. The 'Brain's station' for a pair is the station assemble() put on that value, not a fixed station.
stationSelection.independentStation: From the same NWS station list, the stations NOT among the Brain's 3, ordered by great-circle distance from the lake point; the first one that is within 25.0 mi of the lake, at least 3.0 mi from EVERY Brain station of that lake (so a co-located sensor cannot count as independent), and has at least one archive report in the window. The report records its distance to the lake and to the nearest Brain station. Lakes with none are excluded from 5.2 and 5.3 and counted (reason NO_INDEPENDENT_STATION).
stationSelection.independenceNote: The independent station is never one the Brain reads for that lake. It may be a Brain station for ANOTHER lake; that is allowed (the plan's rule is per lake).

archiveAdapter.source: IEM ASOS/AWOS archive, https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/cgi-bin/request/asos.py, one request per station, report_type 3 (routine) and 4 (specials), tz Etc/UTC, format onlycomma, missing null, trace 0.0001. Fields: tmpf, dwpf, relh, drct, sknt, alti, mslp, p01i, skyc1-4, wxcodes. HFMETAR (1-5 min) reports are NOT used: the NWS observation API serves routine and special METARs.
archiveAdapter.stationId: NWS id with a leading 'K' removed when the id has 4 characters and starts with K (KBFZ -> BFZ, K4A6 -> 4A6); otherwise the id unchanged. A station with no rows in the window is recorded as NOT_IN_ARCHIVE and treated as reporting nothing (the Brain would have had nothing from it either).

mapping.precip_1h_in: p01i (in); the trace value 0.0001 stays below the 0.01 in measurable threshold
mapping.layer_pct: max over skyc1-4 of the Brain's LAYER_PCT table (nws.py)
mapping.text: wxcodes mapped to NWS textDescription wording (table below); null when wxcodes is empty
mapping.icon: null (IEM carries no NWS icon; the Brain's weather_code() falls back to the text, its existing rule)

wxcodesToText.rule: Tokens are space-separated. Each token is matched against the rows below; the token matching the EARLIEST row wins, whatever its position in the string ('BR -RA' -> 'Light Rain'). Intensity prefix of the winning token: '-' -> 'Light ', '+' -> 'Heavy ', none -> ''. Vicinity tokens (VC prefix) match only the VC rows. No match -> text null.
wxcodesToText.note: Whatever this mapping gets wrong is measured by R-SUB presentWeather metrics against the NWS API's own textDescription/icon.

archiveAdapter.knownDifferences: The NWS API drops values with QC flag X or B; IEM carries no QC flag. The NWS API converts from the same METAR groups but quantizes differently. These differences are MEASURED by R-SUB (value agreement and null-versus-value agreement per field), not assumed away.
archiveAdapter.grid: The NWS forecast grid is NOT replayed: no archive of the api.weather.gov gridpoint response exists for the window. assemble() runs with grid = None. Consequences, fixed now: cloud cover comes from observed layers or is null, RAIN_EXPECTED cannot fire and 'rainExpected' is always in 'unknown', so WATCH shares from this replay are NOT reported as the Brain's. CHANGE depends only on OBSERVED events and is unaffected.

substitutionCheck.question: Does the IEM archive give the Brain, and the truth, the same reports the NWS observation API gives?
substitutionCheck.stations: Every Brain station AND every independent-station candidate (truth inputs too), deduplicated.
substitutionCheck.data: For each such station: the NWS observation API (GET /stations/{id}/observations?start=<run time - 7 d>&limit=500, read-only) and the IEM archive for the same 7 days, fetched within one hour of each other.
substitutionCheck.pairing: An NWS report and an IEM report of the same station whose times differ by <= 2 min.

metrics.windDirection: angular diff <= 5 deg, pairs where both speeds >= 5 mph
metrics.presentWeatherPresence: agreement on 'precipitation present' = weather_code(icon, text) in PRECIP_CODES (the Brain's rule), NWS icon+text vs archive text
metrics.presentWeatherCode: equal weather_code when both non-null (REPORTED, no gate: no graded criterion uses the code beyond presence)
metrics.nullAgreement: per field above: share of matched pairs where both are null or both are non-null (QC drops, missing sensors)

marks.minimumPairs: >= 1000 pairs per metric; below that the metric is INSUFFICIENT
marks.perStationCoverageFloor: a station with >= 20 NWS reports and coverage < 0.90 is FLAGGED; a lake whose Brain station or chosen independent station is FLAGGED is excluded from grading and counted (reason SUBSTITUTION_STATION)

gating.rule: Each listed metric must PASS on value agreement AND null agreement, with coverage PASS, for the criterion to be reported PASS. Any of them FAIL, INSUFFICIENT or not run: the criterion carries qualifier SUBSTITUTION_UNCERTAIN; a FAIL is still reported as FAIL, a PASS is reported as NOT_GRADED.

R-5.1R.plan: Replay self-consistency check related to 5.1. It is NOT the plan's 5.1 and can never stand in for it.
R-5.1R.unit: each distinct published value: (lake, tile, station, observation time) for pressure and for air temperature, from assemble() at every instant
checks: provenance: 100 % of values carry a station and an observation time

pressure: (published hPa - recorded seaLevelOffsetHPa, or 0 when kind is altimeter) equals that station's archive altimeter at that time within 0.05 hPa; a slp-only value equals that station's archive mslp within 0.05 hPa
air temperature: equals that station's archive tmpf at that time within 0.1 deg F
R-5.1R.pass: >= 99.5 % of values match AND 100 % provenance (the plan's marks)
R-5.1R.minimumSample: 500 values and 20 lakes; below that INSUFFICIENT
R-5.1R.limit: This replays the reading logic on the archive; it shows the logic never invents, mixes stations or mis-times a value. It cannot show the LIVE publication path is faithful: the plan's 5.1 on published values is required, unchanged.

R-5.2.pairs: The Brain's value at an instant and the independent station's archive report nearest in time within +/- 30 min of the Brain value's observation time. Duplicate pairs (same lake, Brain station, Brain observation time, metric) count once.

metrics.pressureMAE: altimeter to altimeter: the Brain's raw altimeter (published hPa - offset) vs the independent station's alti; slp-only Brain values are excluded and counted. Pass <= 1.0 hPa
metrics.trend3hAgreement: the Brain's trend3h class vs the independent station's 3 h class at its paired report time, both computed by reading.tendency() with the +/-0.02 inHg band on each station's own altimeter series; pairs where either is null are excluded and counted. Pass >= 0.80
metrics.airTempMAE: the Brain's observed air temperature vs the independent station's tmpf. Pass <= 3.0 deg F

R-5.2.minimumSample: per metric: 500 pairs and 20 lakes; below that INSUFFICIENT, never PASS
R-5.2.breakdowns: overall, by the Brain's pressure kind (seaLevel vs altimeter), and by the independent station's distance from the lake (< 10 mi, 10-25 mi)

R-5.3.window: changeSignal_5_3, lakes with an independent station (R-5.2's station rule), minus excludedSpans
R-5.3.brainEvents: signal.evaluate(assemble(...)) at every instant with the v1 thresholds (brains/weather/runtime/knowledge, release weather-knowledge-candidate-2026-11-22.1). Events of one kind at one lake are merged when within 2 h of the previous kept event (the earliest is kept) [amendment addition]. Event time = the event's 'at'.

RAIN_ONSET.truthEvent: [amendment addition] At the independent station: a report with p01i >= 0.01 in, preceded within the previous 3 h by at least one report with non-null p01i and by NO report with p01i >= 0.01 (the rule's own 3 h dry lookback). Stations whose p01i is null in every report of the window are excluded and counted (NO_PRECIP_SENSOR).
RAIN_ONSET.hit: a Brain RAIN_ONSET is a hit if the independent station reports p01i >= 0.01 at any time within +/- 2 h of the event (the plan's truth); otherwise a false alarm
RAIN_ONSET.detected: a truth onset is detected if a Brain RAIN_ONSET falls within +/- 2 h of it
RAIN_ONSET.PODpopulation: PRIMARY (graded, the plan's): ALL truth onsets in the window; a truth onset during which the Brain had no data or could not evaluate the rule counts as a MISS. SECONDARY (reported, labelled, no pass mark): truth onsets with at least one instant within +/- 2 h at which the Brain's rainOnset rule was evaluable.

FRONT_PASSAGE.truthSource: WPC coded surface bulletins (AWIPS PIL CODSUS), read from the IEM NWS text-product archive (https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/cgi-bin/afos/retrieve.py?pil=CODSUS, order requested ascending). For each VALID time the bulletin with the LATEST issuance time (WMO heading DDHHMM) is used, whatever the order the archive returns; a bulletin without a WMO heading ranks below any with one, then by position. Product separators ('000', the WMO heading, the PIL line, the title line) end any feature in progress.
FRONT_PASSAGE.resolution: Only high-resolution bulletins (7-digit coordinates: 3-digit latitude and 4-digit longitude in tenths of a degree, west longitude) are used. 4-5 digit (whole-degree) bulletins are ineligible: a 1 degree position cannot resolve 50 mi. If no eligible bulletin exists in the window, FRONT_PASSAGE is NOT_GRADED with that reason; no other front source is substituted.
FRONT_PASSAGE.frontTypes: COLD, WARM, OCFNT. STNRY (does not pass) and TROF (not a front) are excluded. Intensity words (WK, MDT, STG) are ignored.
FRONT_PASSAGE.truthEpisode: For each lake: the analysis times at which the shortest distance from the lake point to any eligible front polyline is <= 50 mi. Consecutive analyses (3 h apart) form one episode, spanning [first, last].
FRONT_PASSAGE.hit: a Brain FRONT_PASSAGE is a hit if it falls in [first - 3 h, last + 3 h] of an episode at that lake; otherwise a false alarm. [amendment addition] A Brain FRONT_PASSAGE with NO eligible analysis within +/- 3 h cannot be judged: it is excluded from FAR and its count is reported.
FRONT_PASSAGE.detected: an episode is detected if a Brain FRONT_PASSAGE falls in [first - 3 h, last + 3 h]
FRONT_PASSAGE.PODpopulation: PRIMARY (graded, the plan's): ALL episodes; an episode during which the Brain had no data or could not evaluate the rule counts as a MISS. SECONDARY (reported, labelled): episodes with at least one instant in [first - 3 h, last + 3 h] at which the Brain's front rule was evaluable.
FRONT_PASSAGE.distance: great-circle point-to-segment distance computed in a local equirectangular projection centred on the lake; 1 deg latitude = 69.05 mi

R-5.3.minimumSample: NEW in this amendment (the plan states none): per kind, >= 30 truth events in the primary POD population, >= 30 Brain events, from >= 10 lakes; below that INSUFFICIENT
R-5.3.notScored: PRESSURE_*_FAST and AIR_TEMP_SWING (arithmetic on measured data, covered by R-5.1), RAIN_EXPECTED (no grid archive)
R-5.3.alsoReported: CHANGE-hours per lake per week (instants at level CHANGE), no pass mark
R-5.3.onFailure: As the plan: a weather-change-thresholds-v2 proposal with its reason, evaluated on a NEW pre-registered window it was not chosen on; v1 results kept.

rubricMapping.proposal: Retrospective results are evidence for /validation/weather; they do not set it. R-5.1R never stands in for the plan's 5.1. PROPOSED (owner decides): R-5.2 and R-5.3 PASS (with their R-SUB gates PASS) may stand in for the prospective 5.2 and 5.3 windows, making the status PARTIAL once the prospective 5.1 (14 days of published values) passes, and VALIDATED after a prospective WX-001 confirmation window passes. Any retrospective FAIL or INSUFFICIENT is reported and makes the status NOT_VALIDATED until a new pre-registered version passes.
rubricMapping.never: No retrospective result writes /validation/weather, changes a score, adopts the rubric or approves a knowledge release.

methodChanges: Any change after data is examined is recorded in the report (what, why, madeAfterInspectingResults: true) and the affected criterion is re-run on the corrected method with both results kept (Cortex research.md RS-30). Thresholds above are never changed in this protocol id.
